summary: Iteration 7 testing complete. SIDEBAR FIXED BUG RESOLVED. Found root cause: CSS rule '.bg-grain > * { position: relative }' was overriding Tailwind's 'fixed' class. Fixed by changing selector to '.bg-grain > *:not(aside)'. All tests now pass: sidebar stays fixed at top:0 when scrolling, main content offset by 256px, mobile drawer works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ROOT CAUSE FOUND: In /app/frontend/src/index.css line 80, the rule '.bg-grain > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }' was overriding the Tailwind 'fixed' class on the sidebar. Changed to '.bg-grain > *:not(aside)' to exclude the sidebar from this rule.
